question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching Laboratory record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 AND p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_percentage FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

d.request: For patients older than 55, what percentage of those with abnormal prothrombin time (PT ≥ 14) are female? Include patients with no matching Laboratory record in the results.
d.sql: WITH patient_pt AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.PT >= 14) THEN 'Abnormal PT' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.ID = p.ID) THEN 'No abnormal PT' ELSE 'No Laboratory record' END AS pt_status FROM Patient p WHERE p.Birthday < date('now', '-55 years')) SELECT pt_status, COUNT(*) AS patient_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(SEX)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS female_percentage FROM patient_pt GROUP BY pt_status ORDER BY CASE pt_status WHEN 'Abnormal PT' THEN 1 WHEN 'No abnormal PT' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

b.request: Among patients whose current year minus birth year exceeds 55, including those with no Laboratory record, what percentage of joined rows with PT ≥ 14 are for patients whose sex is F?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 AND p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;
